title: Serialize large source-slice inspection
failure_signature: A four-command parallel inspection of large inherited scripts exceeded a thirty-second aggregate budget after only one slice returned.
trigger_preconditions: Parallel aggregate with a thirty-second per-command timeout
candidate_workaround: Read required large script slices serially with a sixty-second bound and credit only commands that exit zero.
recurrence_guard: Do not parallelize large generated-source reads on this host; inspect targeted line ranges serially.
rollback: No source or repository state changed; discard the incomplete aggregate as a review witness while retaining its timeout.
scope_boundary: This method addresses local source-inspection latency only and proves no scientific, production, security, accessibility, identity, authority, or independent-reproduction claim.
